title: Can the overhead crane still pass when a copper-alloy wire annealing-furnace door is raised?
summary: Suneng's May 2026 copper-alloy wire annealing furnace proposal uses four chamber furnaces sharing one loading/unloading fork truck. It explicitly states that the overhead crane can pass when a door is closed but cannot pass when the door is fully raised for unloading. Review both states and coordinate raised-door space, crane travel and truck handling. The parked equipment outline alone does not establish workshop fit.
